facts: MCP is a location node using location.directory, not per-session registration. Current app catalog lists names/status only after trust.

Actual SDK add/remove/connect/disconnect take server plus optional location and return void. list returns location and data array. No SDK public config or process identity postcondition follows from list.
disabled:true registration skips startServer but can replace and dispose existing server; first reserved-name collision must be rejected before add.
Runtime overrides Map is location-local/in-memory. add and remove invoke state.reload; neither writes the user config file.
connect always stops then starts selected entry under lock. disconnect closes scope and marks disabled. Neither void ACK alone establishes exact child process exit.
Connected remote sessions can automatically reconnect on session-expired callbacks or integration switched events. Any explicit-only process/reconnect claim must account for those existing hooks.
Do not enable project:true or filewatcher:true as a shortcut. Native/provider/auth/real MCP server not invoked during this inspection.

Actual remote register() creates OAuth integration/method registration before the disabled start check unless oauth:false; conversion must deliberately retain external-auth boundary and avoid presenting a new built-in auth flow. This source path does not alone prove network activity on disabled registration.
Existing supported file validator permits oauth:false or omitted only. Native default behavior differs between omitted and false; the initial MCP design must resolve that conversion explicitly.
Connecting a workspace location can expose MCP tools/instructions to all sessions in that location; a selected-session-only UI claim would be incorrect.
Native mcp.list exposes location.directory and data[{name,status,integrationID?}]. Validate exact workspace directory and redact integrationID/raw error before public projection.

Native local MCP client resolves config.cwd relative to selected location.directory; an absolute cwd can select another directory. Confirmation and validation must name actual resolved execution directory rather than imply it is always the workspace root.
Native local transport closes via scoped client.close; public SDK still provides no process identity. Actual synthetic child exit evidence and product connection-status claims must be kept distinct.
